active_claims.boundary: Restricted fixed-summary theorem; dimension is not arbitrary circuit cost.

active_claims.title: Weighted witness fingerprint
active_claims.statement: Distinct witness monomials give an exact nonzero/satisfiable equivalence and Boolean top-coefficient identity.
